# Taylor Caton

> Application Manager and full-stack engineer at Bank of America, specializing in web accessibility
> (WCAG 2.2, ADA/Section 508) and platform modernization for large-scale public-facing sites.

Taylor Caton has spent 9 years at Bank of America building and leading development for the bank's
primary public-facing web presence (bankofamerica.com, merrill.com, mymerrill.com). Currently an
Application Manager overseeing delivery, platform stability, and risk across enterprise portfolios,
after a long tenure as Feature Lead. Deep specialization in accessibility, with experience spanning
platform modernization, risk management and governance, incident response, and mentoring engineers
into leadership roles. Background also includes teaching (AP Computer Science, band director) and
music education. This is a single-page portfolio site with no additional pages, forms, or
interactive tools.

## Highlights

- Led the WCAG 2.2 adherence rollout and migration of the Wealth Homepages to an in-house modern
  platform; refactored 35 public-facing sites to ES6 and ADA/WCAG 2.2 compliance over 5 years,
  improving bankofamerica.com's homepage Lighthouse score by 60%.
- Featured Speaker at Grace Hopper Celebration 2023 (Orlando, FL), "Writing Accessible Code for
  All"; moderated a Web Accessibility panel for NCWiT.
- Co-built an AI-driven image optimization tool (Python, Golang, Shell, Node.js) that reduced image
  and streaming video payloads by 35%. Winner, Internal Innovation Challenge 2022.
- Skills: JavaScript/TypeScript, Vue, React, Node.js, Java, Python, Golang, WCAG 2.1/2.2 and
  Section 508 compliance, CSP remediation and secure coding, CMS platform migration (Adobe
  Experience Manager), Linux (Red Hat).
